facts.text: The hotel sits along the sands of Palm Beach in Aruba.
facts.excerpt: Perched along the soft sands of Palm Beach, The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba embodies the rich spirit of this beautiful Caribbean island.

facts.text: Refurbished suites and guest rooms use design motifs inspired by Aruba's beaches, sea and desert landscapes.
facts.excerpt: with locally inspired design motifs by Aruba’s beaches, sea, and desert landscapes.

facts.text: Casa Nonna New York is the hotel's Italian restaurant and serves freshly made pasta.
facts.excerpt: Our Aruba Italian restaurant, Casa Nonna New York, offers freshly-made pasta, while BLT Steak features premium meats and seafood.

facts.text: BLT Steak serves premium meats and seafood.
facts.excerpt: BLT Steak features premium meats and seafood.

facts.text: Madero Pool & Beach Grill offers poolside dining, and there is a Madero fire pit for handcrafted cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy poolside dining at Madero Pool & Beach Grill or experience handcrafted cocktails by the Madero fire pit.

facts.text: Signature spa treatments showcase aloe, coffee and other indigenous ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Aloe, coffee and other indigenous ingredients are showcased in signature treatments

facts.text: The spa is a beachfront sanctuary.
facts.excerpt: Within a 15,000-sq. ft. beachfront sanctuary, The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Aruba offers healing and relaxation

facts.text: Non-motorized watersports equipment, including snorkeling gear, paddleboards, kayaks and water hammocks, is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba offers a host of complimentary non-motorized watersports equipment, including snorkeling gear, paddleboards, kayaks, and water hammocks.

facts.text: The resort has a Family Pool and an Adults-Only Relaxation Pool, as well as a hot tub.
facts.excerpt: The Resort features two pools – a Family Pool and Adults-Only Relaxation Pool as well as a Hot Tub.

facts.text: The supervised Ritz Kids program is designed for children ages 4 through 12.
facts.excerpt: Designed for children ages 4 through 12, the supervised program

facts.text: Ritz Kids programs are offered seasonally.
facts.excerpt: Ritz Kids Programs Are Offered Seasonally

facts.text: The hotel allows one dog per room and has a dedicated Pet Concierge.
facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba allows one dog per room throughout their stay.

facts.text: Club Level is on the seventh floor and has a lounge with ocean views.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the seventh floor, Club® Level guests are invited to enjoy beautiful ocean views in a comfortable lounge.

facts.text: The hotel was the first Ritz-Carlton resort in the Dutch Caribbean.
facts.excerpt: The property opened in November 2013 and was the first-ever Ritz-Carlton resort in the Dutch Caribbean.

facts.text: The hotel is the closest large property to the California Lighthouse.
facts.excerpt: It’s also the closest large property to the island’s California Lighthouse.

facts.text: The poolside pop-up bar operates from a renovated VW bus.
facts.excerpt: You can’t miss the property's poolside pop-up bar that’s set up shop in a renovated VW bus

facts.text: Spa appointments are required.
facts.excerpt: Appointment required

facts.text: Tierra del Sol, the island's only 18-hole championship golf course, is minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Golfers should know that just minutes away from the resort, Tierra del Sol has the only 18-hole championship golf course on the island.

facts.text: The hotel has an on-site casino.
facts.excerpt: Let The Casino at The Ritz-Carlton, Aruba elevate your evenings with a roll of the dice.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler lists the hotel among its Readers' Choice Awards for 2018 and 2026.
